title: Report real doctor fixture worker failures without waiting for the readiness guard
outcome: An early real worker failure in the doctor deadline test helper surfaces its actual error promptly through the readiness path, without waiting for the existing 60-second deadlock guard or changing production doctor timing.
acceptance: A deterministic test demonstrates that a real worker error before descendant readiness releases the readiness wait and reports that worker error.
Cleanup remains bounded and preserves process/tree/pipe ownership; production deadlines and timeout values remain unchanged.
